answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1063 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the quill. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the karst queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. The walnut index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 67 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
